 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Matchday 7 of the Bundesliga pits two of the season's most in-form teams against each other as Mainz welcome Werder Bremen to the Mewa Arena this afternoon.
 With kick-off scheduled in around an hour's time at 15:30 CET, both coaches have announced their starting lineups and you can see all the details below.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Confirmed Mainz 05 vs. Werder Bremen lineups:
 Mainz 05 (3-3-2-2): Schwolow – Da Costa, Posch, Potulski – Caci, Sano, Mwene – Amiri, Lee – Becker, Tietz
 Werder Bremen (4-2-3-1): Hein – Arthur, Pieper, Friedl, Deman – Regeer, Reis – Weiser, Chuki, Grüll – Füllkrug
